key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as an unguarded inline `d.set(nullptr)` and leaves the QThreadData::currentThreadData() check (and the qthread_p.h include) at the qcollator call site, so the new public API can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown; (B) moves that guard into an exported QThreadStorageData::clear(), making clearLocalData() unconditionally shutdown-safe and simplifying the holder by inheriting from QThreadStorage<GenerationalCollator>.
